Research Assistant:
When you do the Share Intel action, you may give any 1 City card.
When others Share Intel with you, they may take any 1 City card from you.

Cover
When playing with a temporary alias, for every cover you would scratch, discard 1 card (if you have any) instead.

TEMPORARY ALIAS

Medical Conference Coordinator:
As an action, you may move a team or a different player's pawn up to 3 cities away from its current city.
(The team/pawn does not enter any cities in between.)

Cover
When playing with a temporary alias, for every cover you would scratch, discard 1 card (if you have any) instead.

TEMPORARY ALIAS

Hospital Administrator:
You may do the Assemble Team action with one fewer card.

Cover
When playing with a temporary alias, for every cover you would scratch, discard 1 card (if you have any) instead.

TEMPORARY ALIAS

Clinic Planner:
When you do the Build Safehouse action, you do not need a City card.
As an action, while at a safehouse, discard a City card to move to any city on the board.

Cover
When playing with a temporary alias, for every cover you would scratch, discard 1 card (if you have any) instead.

PANDEMIC LEGACY SEASON 0

Hello agent,

Thank you for acquiring Pandemic Legacy: Season 0. We hope you will have as much fun playing it as we had making it. The necessary intel for this mission is as follows:

Dossiers and Packages
Do not open any doors on the dossiers or any of the safe deposit boxes (numbered boxes in the game box) until instructed to do so.

Debrief Book
There are two books, the rulebook and the debrief book. Read the rulebook to learn the rules of the game, but do not read anything from the debrief book except as instructed. When reading the debrief book, read only the entry you are instructed to read.

The Legacy Deck
The Legacy deck comes in two parts: Part 1 and Part 2. Begin with Part 1, and do not open Part 2 until you have completed Part 1. Be sure to open both parts from the beginning of the deck, not the end. Read and reveal the cards in numerical order, and only when instructed to do so.

Thank you again, and good luck. This will be a year long remembered (by those with the proper clearance). You have been called upon to save humanity. You must be up to the task.

-Matt Leacock, Rob Daviau, and the Z-Man Games team
